mapper.sql: a.id,a.project_id,p.project_name,'REPORT' AS asset_type,a.doc_code AS asset_code,a.doc_name AS asset_name,f.content_type,f.file_size,m.attachment_id,a.report_period,a.report_date,a.keywords,a.owner_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,a.created_by,a.updated_by,a.deleted_by,a.deleted_at

FROM dm_report a LEFT JOIN dm_content_attachment m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.business_type='REPORT' AND m.business_id=a.id AND m.sort_order=0 AND m.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN att_file f ON f.id=m.attachment_id AND f.tenant_id=m.tenant_id LEFT JOIN pm_project p ON a.project_id=p.id AND p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.deleted=0

WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.deleted=10 AND a.report_period=#{reportPeriod} AND (a.doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR a.keywords LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY a.doc_code ASC,a.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT WHERE a.id=#{id} AND a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.deleted=10
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_report updated_by=#{p.updatedBy},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,report_period=#{p.reportPeriod},doc_name=#{p.docName},report_date=#{p.reportDate},keywords=#{p.keywords} WHERE id=#{p.id} AND tenant_id=#{p.tenantId}
UPDATE dm_report SET deleted=1,deleted_by=#{deletedBy},deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_report SET deleted=0,deleted_by=NULL,deleted_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_report WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.select: SELECT id,project_name FROM pm_project WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY project_name
